initiator: human Inspector with explicit write consent
host_resolution: Resolve canonical repository root, worktree Git directory, common Git directory, index and object format through the trusted host.

Refuse caller GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE, object-directory/alternate-object overrides, symlink administration components, submodule targets, split/sparse index and unsupported index representation.
Caller supplies no physical index, lock, object-directory or administration path.

supported_index.tree_extension: Validate framing then discard the invalidated cache-tree extension on publication; it never supplies entry authority.
supported_index.unknown_extension: Refuse before mutation. Do not silently discard mandatory or unfamiliar optional extensions.
supported_index.entry_validation: Verify full file checksum, entry counts, canonical sorted unique path/stage pairs, exact lengths/NUL/padding, regular supported modes and flags. Reject extended/intent-to-add/skip-worktree representations until deliberately supported.
supported_index.semantic_witness: Canonical sorted path/mode/blob/stage/semantic flags; exclude only filesystem stat cache fields. Bind all non-proof entries separately.

publication: Before any mutation validate actual trusted Owner approval and predecessor phase, complete custody and passing native chain/anchor verification; validate the exact working chain bytes and derived Git blob identity.
Acquire the REAL resolved index.lock exclusively. Never use alternate-index locking or unrestricted git add/update-index.
Under the held lock reread actual parents, source, phase, chain and index. Compare the approved semantic witness and all other entries.
Remove only the declared proof entry's unresolved stages and install its verified stage0 regular-file blob/mode. Preserve every other entry's raw bytes and semantic identity.

Materialize only the exact verified content-addressed blob object if absent. Verify existing object contents instead of replacing it. Object publication is an explicit child effect of this logical boundary, never a broad object-directory grant.
Write the complete checksummed index into the owned index.lock, flush it, atomically rename onto the real index, flush its parent, then return the exact new semantic witness and publication identity.
An ambiguous post-publication error preserves complete object/index/lock/phase evidence and reports unknown durability. Never delete a foreign successor or roll back published proof history.
exact_effect_recipes: trusted-host-resolved-git-dir/index.lock (exclusive lock and complete staged index)
prohibited: ref update, commit, push or merge commit
caller-created resource or receipt as authority
force removal, age-based lock stealing or unknown-file cleanup
test_requirements: Real linked-worktree administration outside checkout, both object formats and valid cache-tree extension.
Two actual processes contend on real index.lock; loser preserves winner bytes/inode and all unrelated entries.
Stale semantic index/parents/source/phase/chain and foreign logical/physical identity refuse.
Unknown extension/version, bad checksum, flags, malformed path, symlink, override and foreign lock refuse before dependent mutation.
Crash or fault at each durable object/index boundary preserves old-or-new complete index and exact owned/foreign custody; retry cannot broaden the approved phase.
implementation_standing: No adapter or runtime target is implemented by this design document. Exact source ownership and closed runtime schemas remain required before writer edits.
